RP_IDEOLOGY_TRIBALISM_DESC: Tribal order: rule of the chieftain and elders. Weak centralization — low loyalty and simple technology, but dissent builds slowly.
RP_IDEOLOGY_MONARCHY_DESC: Hereditary monarchy: stable rule with high legitimacy. A moderate order, strong unity, inclined toward vassalage.
RP_IDEOLOGY_THEOCRACY_DESC: Theocracy: power held by the clergy. A highly cohesive society that actively converts neighbours, but barely tolerates dissent.
RP_IDEOLOGY_ARISTOCRACY_DESC: Aristocratic republic: noble houses rule. A balanced order with moderate legitimacy and noble influence.
RP_IDEOLOGY_MERCHANTREPUBLIC_DESC: Merchant republic: merchants and guilds hold power. Fast growth and advanced technology, peaceful, drawn to progressive reforms.
RP_IDEOLOGY_MILITARISM_DESC: Militarism: everything serves the army and conquest. High war appetite and cohesion, but dissent is crushed hard.
RP_IDEOLOGY_EGALITARIANISM_DESC: Egalitarian commune: equality and self-governance. High loyalty and cohesion, progressive order, peace-loving.
RP_IDEOLOGY_TECHNOCRACY_DESC: Technocracy: scientists and engineers rule. The most advanced technology and reforms, but elitism lowers the people's loyalty.
RP_IDEOLOGY_LIBERALISM_DESC: Liberalism: parliament, universal suffrage, open borders and free trade. Grows rich fast, but inequality breeds resentment and war strangles the market.

RP_THREAT_RECOVERED: {kingdom}: the "{threat}" crisis is over — after {years} years the realm has recovered. What it means: the turmoil ended, the threat meter builds up again from zero
RP_POWER_TRIBALISM_DESC: The chief calls every clan: 5 years of unity, high spirits and fading discontent. Only for small tribes at peace. Cooldown 25 years.
RP_THREAT_TRIBALISM_DESC: The more cities a tribe holds, the faster the clans drift apart. When the bar fills, the tribe splits: discord and collapsing morale.
RP_THREAT_TRIBALISM_BREAK: {kingdom}: the clans have fallen out — the tribe is splitting. What it means: the tribe's core threat fired — happiness drops, a city may secede
RP_POWER_MONARCHY_DESC: The crown seals an alliance by blood: 15 years of firm order and good repute. Requires peace and a neighbour. Cooldown 30 years.
RP_THREAT_MONARCHY_DESC: An ageing ruler with weak support shakes the throne. When the bar fills, turmoil and collapsing trust follow.
RP_THREAT_MONARCHY_BREAK: {kingdom}: a dynastic crisis has begun. The model uses ruler age and legitimacy; it does not confirm the absence of an heir. Unrest and provincial secession are possible.
RP_POWER_THEOCRACY_DESC: The temple proclaims a righteous cause: 10 years of zeal, dissenters fall silent. Requires war or notable dissent. Cooldown 35 years.
RP_THREAT_THEOCRACY_DESC: Every dissenter erodes the faith. When the bar fills, heresy erupts: discord and lost unity.
RP_THREAT_THEOCRACY_BREAK: {kingdom}: heresy has split the faithful. What it means: the theocracy's threat — schism: happiness drops, a heretic city may secede
RP_POWER_ARISTOCRACY_DESC: Lands are granted to the nobility: 12 years of a wealthy capital at the cost of common trust. Requires at least two cities. Cooldown 25 years.
RP_THREAT_ARISTOCRACY_DESC: In peaceful years the nobles scheme; war distracts them. When the bar fills, the plot breaks out and strikes the top of power.
RP_THREAT_ARISTOCRACY_BREAK: {kingdom}: a noble conspiracy uncovered. What it means: the aristocracy's threat — noble revolt: happiness drops, a baron may take a city away
RP_POWER_MERCHANTREPUBLIC_DESC: The merchants strike a grand pact: 20 years of gold flowing into every city. Requires peace and a neighbour. Cooldown 25 years.
RP_THREAT_MERCHANTREPUBLIC_DESC: War fills the debt bar fast; peace drains it. When it fills, the treasury is wiped out.
RP_THREAT_MERCHANTREPUBLIC_BREAK: {kingdom}: debts have ruined the treasury. What it means: the republic's threat — debt collapse: treasury drained, a port city may secede
RP_POWER_MILITARISM_DESC: The realm takes up arms: 10 years of a stronger host, paid for with the peace of its people. Only during war. Cooldown 30 years.
RP_THREAT_MILITARISM_DESC: Every year of war piles on weariness; peace heals it. When the bar fills, the country breaks: a heavy collapse of morale.
RP_THREAT_MILITARISM_BREAK: {kingdom}: army and people are worn out by war. What it means: the militarist threat — army disbanded, happiness drops, a garrison may secede
RP_POWER_EGALITARIANISM_DESC: The people decide: the realm immediately adopts the ideology held by most of its inhabitants. Called when rulers drift from the people. Cooldown 20 years.
RP_THREAT_EGALITARIANISM_DESC: The more mixed the people's beliefs, the harder it is to agree. When the bar fills, government stalls: discord and impotence.
RP_THREAT_EGALITARIANISM_BREAK: {kingdom}: endless debate has paralysed the government. What it means: the egalitarian threat — paralysis: happiness drops, the discontented may secede
RP_POWER_TECHNOCRACY_DESC: The learned attempt the unheard-of: 15 years of a growing capital at the cost of trust in power. Requires peace and solid support. Cooldown 40 years.
RP_THREAT_TECHNOCRACY_DESC: When support falls, the knowledgeable leave. When the bar fills, the realm loses its best: a marked decline.
RP_THREAT_TECHNOCRACY_BREAK: {kingdom}: the finest minds are leaving the realm. What it means: the technocratic threat — brain drain: happiness drops, a city may secede
RP_POWER_LIBERALISM_DESC: Tariffs abolished: for 15 years the treasury and public mood grow, borders are open to all. Declared in peacetime when support or legitimacy slips. Cooldown 25 years.
RP_THREAT_LIBERALISM_DESC: A free market without popular support breeds the resentment of the poor; war strangles trade. When the bar fills — unrest and riots.
RP_THREAT_LIBERALISM_BREAK: {kingdom}: the gap between rich and poor has erupted into riots. What it means: the liberal threat — revolt of the poor: treasury drained, a city may secede

RP_IDEOLOGY_DEMOCRACY_DESC: Rule of the people: free elections, high tech, and dissent tolerance.
RP_POWER_DEMOCRACY_DESC: Consolidates society, boosts support, and reduces polarization.
RP_POWER_DEMOCRACY_USE: {kingdom}: national referendum declared. Referendum — democratic special action: society unites, support rises, polarization fades
RP_THREAT_DEMOCRACY_DESC: Grows from dissent and prolonged wars; paralyzes government institutions upon crisis.
RP_THREAT_DEMOCRACY_BREAK: {kingdom}: polarization crisis — government institutions paralyzed. What it means: the democratic threat — polarization: treasury drained, happiness drops, a city may secede
RP_IDEOLOGY_COMMUNISM_DESC: Planned economy, high cohesion, and revolutionary drive at the expense of free dissent.
RP_POWER_COMMUNISM_DESC: State mobilization of resources provides a massive influx of food, stone, and gold.
RP_POWER_COMMUNISM_USE: {kingdom}: five-year industrial plan initiated. Five-Year Plan — communist special action: cities build and supply faster, but people are worn down
RP_THREAT_COMMUNISM_DESC: Builds during peace when popular support drops; leads to shortages and strikes.

RP_IDEOLOGY_ETHNONATIONALISM_DESC: Absolute supremacy of the titular nation, military drive, and intolerance toward aliens.
RP_POWER_ETHNONATIONALISM_DESC: Mobilizes the entire titular population for sacred defense and conquest.
RP_POWER_ETHNONATIONALISM_USE: {kingdom}: national triumph and mass mobilization proclaimed. National Triumph — ethnonationalist special action: the titular people unite, the army is stronger
RP_THREAT_ETHNONATIONALISM_DESC: Builds from alien cities and foreign pressure; sparks minority uprisings.
RP_THREAT_ETHNONATIONALISM_BREAK: {kingdom}: interethnic revolt erupted across minority provinces. What it means: the ethnonationalist threat — minority uprising: happiness drops, a foreign city may secede

RP_CONST_MIGRATION_OPEN: Anyone may leave: both the home realm and the host realm review the request. If both agree, the person simply moves. If home refuses but the host agrees, the person may flee — crossing the border makes them a citizen of the new realm.
RP_CONST_MIGRATION_CONTROLLED: Leaving requires permission from the home realm. The content are released, the unhappy are not. If home refuses but the host agrees, the person may flee across the border.
RP_CONST_MIGRATION_CLOSED: Nobody may leave: the border is closed. Attempting to flee is punished, but the desperate still try.
RP_CONST_RACES_PROTECT: All peoples are equal. Small peoples are protected by law: they are not pushed out, they are helped to keep their language and customs, and those who wish to leave are not stopped.
RP_CONST_RACES_IGNORE: The law does not distinguish between peoples: whatever happens, happens. The strong people push out the weak and nobody interferes.
RP_CONST_RACES_OPRESS: One people is declared master of the realm. The others must dissolve into it: their language and customs are not protected, they are resettled and oppressed. That is why they flee to realms that treat them differently.

RP52_CONST_RACE_TITULAR: The native people have more rights than newcomers: newcomers live, work and pay taxes but are not called to high office
RP52_CONST_RACE_SEG: Newcomers may only live and work. Their own language and court are taken away, so their children gradually forget the language of their fathers
RP52_CONST_RACE_EQUAL: All peoples are equal before the law: native and newcomer go to the same court and pay the same taxes
RP52_CONST_LANG_FREE: Every people teaches its children its own language. In state affairs everyone uses the common tongue; at home and in the community, their own. So a people lives with two cultures and does not vanish
RP52_CONST_LANG_COMMON: The state has one common language: in schools, courts and affairs — only it. Family languages are not forbidden but not supported, and in two or three generations they are forgotten
RP52_CONST_COURT_OWN: Disputes inside a community are settled by its own people under its own customs; the state court takes only grave cases
RP52_CONST_COURT_COMMON: One court for all: native and newcomer are judged by common law, and community customs are not recognised
RP52_CONST_LOCAL_BANNED: Cities may not write their own charters: the law of the state is one for all. If a city with a foreign people thinks otherwise, that is its business — but it gets no charter
RP52_CONST_LOCAL_STRICT: A city where more than half the people are newcomers may write its own charter. But if it conflicts with this law, the capital will not tolerate it and demands conformity
RP52_CONST_LOCAL_FREE: A city where more than half the people are newcomers may write its own charter, and the capital tolerates differences from common law: different customs do live side by side
